text:
maria: Heads-up — spotted an inconsistency in auth telemetry sampling across hosted vs private during Canary 3. Some service-account flows are under-sampled.
aj: ugh, can you paste an example trace?
sam: saw this earlier with project-scoped API keys — sampling rate looked like 0.01 instead of the 0.1 baseline.
maria: here's a snippet from the logging pipeline showing the sampler key we use: 
```json
{"sampler":"auth_surface_v1","default_rate":0.1,"overrides":{}}
```
kelly: are the overrides coming from routing labels or config sync?
maria: looks like an edge case where private deployments default to local-config (no override synced), so the sampler falls back to an old default of 0.01.
aj: that explains it. Private installs didn't get the sampler bump we rolled for hosted.
sam: impact is mostly observability blind spots for service accounts — quotas/alerts won't trigger. We missed a regression in canary because of that.
maria: proposal: (1) add a config check in the rollout script that validates sampler parity, (2) expose a console QA card showing sampling coverage per auth-type, and (3) add a short-lived telemetry alert for sudden drops in auth-surface sampling. Thoughts?
kelly: +1 for console QA card. Design idea: show three bars — api-keys, sa, org-tokens — with sampling % and last-sync ts.
aj: for rollout script check, we could fail the canary if any auth-type sampling < 0.05 unless opt-in flag set. That keeps canaries honest.
sam: careful—some customers intentionally run low sampling. We need an allowlist: 
`--allowlist-deployments=deployment-a,deployment-b`
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary flag applied to canary-3 at 1717779200.
maria: good call on allowlist. Updated proposal: fail canary unless (sampling >= 0.05) OR deployment in allowlist OR customer-managed flag present. Also add a migration job that syncs hosted sampler defaults to private clusters on next metadata refresh.
aj: I'll sketch the rollout script change. Sam, can you prototype the console card mock? Kelly, mind pairing on the alert definition?
sam: yep, will whip a quick mock in Figma and post here.
kelly: will draft alert runbook and channel mapping.
maria: thanks — target: gate the next canary (canary-4) with this in place. I'll open a follow-up PR for the migration job and mark it WIP. :white_check_mark:
aj: ping me when PR is up. :eyes:
